What AI tools are you currently using today and how are you using them?
checks.expected: Today, in my current Research Engineer Intern role at Arborphy AI, I’m using EfficientNet, BioCLIP, and DINOv3 to study plant-identification models and representation quality. I use frozen linear probes, clustering, nearest-neighbor retrieval, local PCA rotations, and centroid shrinkage to understand whether representations capture species identity, organ morphology, or photographic-scale confounding. I’m also building evaluation loops: individual- and species-disjoint benchmarks for species identification, organ classification, and cross-species retrieval, plus human-review sets for model errors. On the agent side, I’ve built a multi-agent botanical reasoning prototype with autonomous tool generation, visual-analysis agents, constrained planning, per-step information-gain evaluation, and knowledge-graph evidence aggregation. That maps closely to assistant quality work: retrieval, grounding, evaluation, and iterative improvement.
